Quantity Decrease quantity for The OLD TIMER | 3 in 1 pedal Increase quantity for The OLD TIMER | 3 in 1 pedal Add to cart     Description The Old Timer Now the official secrets act has been removed for SP3 I can now announce the OLD TIMER. The OLD TIMER is a 3 in one pedal with super flexible IO backboard and expression pedal input. The first effect in the chain is the Octave Fuzz based on the Tycobrahe Octavia. Old school cool with transformer and the ability to lift the octave and use it to create walls of fuzz. The second effect is our take on the venerable fuzz face in the form of the TACIT BLUE. Finally the third effect is our take on a univibe, the ER-2 (block2) version. Combined you have the most amazing wall of modulating textured fuzz. We will be releasing these in small batches of 10-20. please allow up to 8 weeks for them to be built
